evaluations.prompt: Last day of my rocm-libraries gardener week. Sweep post-merge CI on every PR I merged this week and write the handover doc plus the Teams message.
expected_behavior: Re-read live pull request state before writing the handover
Treat a merge commit with zero workflow runs as a finding
Keep the Teams message in phrases, with a bold verb first and no table
unexpected_behavior: Leave a private note path or an internal-only link in the handover

evaluations.prompt: While writing the gardener handover I see an open PR whose autoMergeRequest is now set. What action do I hand to the next gardener?
expected_behavior: Tell the next gardener to leave that pull request alone

evaluations.prompt: For the handover, should I open a follow-up to confirm the standalone mirror of a component I merged?
expected_behavior: Check auto_subtree_push before opening a mirror item

evaluations.prompt: Please classify the failing checks on https://github.com/ROCm/rocm-libraries/pull/10250. The reporter wants to know if they are infra.
Map the failed jobs on today's ROCm/TheRock bump pull requests and post the bump tracker to the Gardening-Bump-PR channel.
